display.purpose: Hero identity and section names; second line painted in the ghost colour.

body.purpose: Role summaries, tool kinds, skill lists, and form labels.

motion.name: dock-hover
motion.purpose: Icon colour and background on hover only.

motion.name: feature-arrow
motion.purpose: Two-pixel diagonal nudge of the feature card arrow.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables all transitions and smooth scrolling.

components.name: Icon dock
components.description: Centred translucent pill holding five icon links to the page's sections.
components.css: .ds-dock { position: absolute; top: 30px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 3%); } .ds-dock a { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; color: #fff; }

components.name: Profile card
components.description: Sticky white sheet carrying the portrait, name, bio, contact links, and language switch.
components.html: Muhamad Fatah Rozaq
components.css: .ds-profile { position: sticky; top: 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 22px; width: 344px; padding: 30px 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #151312; text-align: center; overflow: hidden; } .ds-profile img { width: 240px; height: 284px; border-radius: 16px; object-fit: cover; } .ds-profile .name { font: 700 22px/1.15 Poppins, sans-serif; }

components.name: Feature card
components.description: Saturated panel with a mark, a 24px statement, and a bordered arrow.
components.html:
✳

BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE, SALES FORCE AUTOMATION

↗
components.css: .ds-feature { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; min-height: 240px; padding: 40px 20px 22px; border-radius: 10px; background: #ef6230; color: #fff; } .ds-feature p { margin: 0; font: 500 24px/1.1 Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-feature .arrow { position: absolute; right: 20px; bottom: 22px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 8px; opacity: .65; }

components.name: Submit
components.description: Full-width orange action that composes a mail draft.
components.css: .ds-submit { width: 100%; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #f46c38; color: #151312; font: 600 13px Poppins, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-submit:hover { background: #ff7f4d; } .ds-submit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f46c38; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: The Sawad Folio, Filled With Real Work
narrative.overview: The Sawad Framer template's layout and visual language carried by the owner's real CV, portrait, projects, roles, tools, and contact details.
keyCharacteristics: Sticky white profile card beside oversized two-tone headings.
Icon dock centred above the content.
Alternating white and ghost heading lines.
English and Indonesian copy switched in place.

rules.name: Two-Tone Rule
rules.body: Every display heading pairs a white first line with a ghost second line.

rules.name: Sticky Rail Rule
rules.body: The profile card sticks at 40px inside a full-height rail; the page must stay overflow-x: clip.

rules.name: Ghost Contrast Exception
rules.body: Ghost heading lines measure 1.47:1 against the ink ground, matching the reference template. The heading's aria-label carries the full text; raising the ghost to #5e5c60 restores AA.

dos: Keep the 344/696 split and the 120px section rhythm.
Keep every fact and link traceable to the CV.
donts: Do not import the template's stock project art or invented metrics.
Do not publish the CV phone number.
Do not use overflow: hidden on the page shell.
